programs.description: Poor bride faces wealthy father-in-law's wrath after he cruelly tries to separate his son from his wife and child, but fate intervenes.
A comprehensive compilation of some of the best devotional songs by various artists in praise of the various gods and goddesses.
Mahamaya, a woman with visual impairment, slowly wins the heart of Parameshwar, who married her by force. However, the arrival of her childhood sweetheart causes a stir.
A young man falls in love with his sister-in-law's sister. All is well until his parents disapprove of his brother's choice, thus jeopardising his relationship.
When his sister Sandhya is raped and murdered by Ratan, Shankar decides to seek revenge. In his mission, he receives the support of his long-lost childhood friend, Rajib, who is now a police officer.
A comprehensive compilation of blockbuster Bengali songs, performed by various artists, is played back-to-back.
Bijoy is jailed after being framed by Bilas Dutta, a famous businessman, and unable to deal with it, his sister commits suicide. When he is released from prison, Bijoy vows to seek revenge.
Priya receives a faulty car from her devious uncle and accidentally strikes Arjun. Since he possesses amnesia, the male consequently loves her.

After a child princess is gifted a harmonium, she soon gets orphaned, then widowed and lastly left penniless. After the harmonium is sold, it brings bad luck to whomsoever owns it.

Reporter Akash's romance with Ratri faces a harrowing test when she endures a vicious assault after challenging local injustice.

An avid traveller from a wealthy family marries a woman during one of his travails. However, tragedy strikes after he embarks on another sojourn after marriage, unaware that his wife is pregnant.
